greet.response_template: Hello! I am the Zenith Nova HR assistant. Ask me about leave, payslips, attendance or policies.

hr_policy_leave.response_template: You get 12 casual leave and 12 sick leave days each financial year, plus earned leave at 1.25 days per month (carry forward up to 30 days).

working_hours.response_template: Office hours are 9:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday, with core hours from 11:00 to 16:00.

holiday_list.response_template: The holiday calendar is published each year. The next holiday is {next_holiday}.

payslip_date.response_template: Salary is credited on the first working day of the next month.

apply_leave_howto.response_template: Open the Leave screen, choose the leave type and dates, then submit. Your manager gets an approval request.

reimbursement_policy.response_template: Submit bills within 30 days in the Expenses screen. Your head of department approves, Finance pays in the next cycle.

who_to_contact.response_template: Payroll queries: payroll@znova-demo.example. Benefits and policies: hr@znova-demo.example. IT: it-help@znova-demo.example.

wfh_policy.response_template: Most roles follow a hybrid pattern with about three office days a week. Remote roles are listed in your offer letter.

notice_period_policy.response_template: Notice is 30 days (L1-L2), 60 days (L3) or 90 days (L4 and above). Buy-out needs HR and manager approval.

probation_policy.response_template: Probation is six months. Confirmation is reviewed by your manager and HR.

insurance_benefits.response_template: Group health insurance covers you, spouse and up to two children. Add dependents within 30 days of joining or a life event.

pf_info.response_template: PF is 12% of basic salary (ceiling 15,000 basic) from both you and the company.

tax_declaration.response_template: Upload investment proofs in the Tax screen before the cut-off. TDS is calculated on projected annual income.

faq.question: How many casual leaves do I get?
faq.answer: 12 days per financial year, prorated for joiners.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: How many sick leaves do I get?
faq.answer: 12 days per financial year. A medical certificate is needed beyond 2 days.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: How does earned leave work?
faq.answer: It accrues at 1.25 days per month and up to 30 days can be carried forward.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: Is leave without pay allowed?
faq.answer: Yes, when other balances are exhausted. It is deducted on a calendar-day basis.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: What is the maternity leave policy?
faq.answer: 26 weeks of paid maternity leave as per statute.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: What are the office hours?
faq.answer: 9:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday. Core hours are 11:00 to 16:00.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: Do we have to work on Saturdays?
faq.answer: No. Saturday and Sunday are weekly offs.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: How does overtime pay work?
faq.answer: Eligible roles (L1-L2 in Support, HR, Finance, Operations) get 2x hourly pay, capped at 50 hours a month.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: When is salary paid?
faq.answer: On the first working day of the following month.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: How is LOP calculated?
faq.answer: Monthly fixed pay divided by calendar days, multiplied by days without pay.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: When is the performance bonus paid?
faq.answer: With the April payroll, based on the latest appraisal rating, for employees with 12 months of service.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: How often are salaries revised?
faq.answer: Annually from 1 April, based on the appraisal rating. Promotions can happen at the same time.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: How is PF calculated?
faq.answer: 12% of basic, with a wage ceiling of 15,000 basic per month, from employee and employer.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: Who is covered by ESI?
faq.answer: Employees whose monthly fixed gross is 21,000 or less.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: What is professional tax?
faq.answer: A state tax of 200 per month for employees earning 25,000 or more a month (sample rule).
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: How is TDS decided?
faq.answer: On projected annual income using the slabs shown in the Tax screen, spread across 12 months.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: When do I get Form 16?
faq.answer: After the financial year closes, usually by mid June.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: How long is the notice period?
faq.answer: 30 days for L1-L2, 60 days for L3, 90 days for L4 and above.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: Can I buy out my notice period?
faq.answer: Yes, with manager and HR approval, by paying the shortfall in notice pay.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: What is the probation period?
faq.answer: Six months, reviewed by manager and HR.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: What is the work from home policy?
faq.answer: Hybrid, about three office days a week for most roles. Some roles are fully remote.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: How do I claim travel expenses?
faq.answer: Submit bills within 30 days in the Expenses screen.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: Who approves my expenses?
faq.answer: Your head of department approves; Finance pays in the next cycle.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: What insurance do I have?
faq.answer: Group health cover for you, spouse and up to two children.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: How do I add a dependent to insurance?
faq.answer: Within 30 days of joining or a life event, through the Benefits screen.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: What training is available?
faq.answer: Each employee gets a learning budget and access to the online library; target is 24 hours a year.
faq.policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

faq.question: How do I update my bank details?
faq.answer: Raise a request in the Profile screen; HR verifies within 3 working days.

faq.question: How are holidays decided?
